news.title: 2 arrested after overnight shooting in Sweet Auburn, police say
news.summary: Two men were arrested following an early Saturday morning shooting in Sweet Auburn, according to police.

news.title: Gwinnett County Police investigate deadly Buford triple-shooting
news.summary: A triple shooting in Buford left one man dead and sent two others to the hospital Saturday morning.

news.title: Triple shooting in Gwinnett County leaves 1 dead
news.summary: Gwinnett County police are investigating a homicide that has left one person dead and two others hurt Saturday morning.

news.title: Shooting in Buford leaves 1 dead, 2 injured; Gwinnett Police seek witnesses
news.summary: A man is dead and two are injured in a Buford shooting, Gwinnett Police report. Authorities are probing the Saturday incident and seeking witnesses for insight.

news.title: Atlanta police detain two suspects after early-morning shooting on Jackson St SE
news.summary: Two men are in custody facing multiple charges after an early-morning shooting in Atlanta, police say. A woman was injured but has been treated and released.

news.title: Metro Atlanta man convicted 40 years after serial rape spree
news.summary: A metro Atlanta man already serving a life sentence for a series of violent sex crimes has now been convicted in six cold case rapes that terrorized a community nearly 40 years ago.

news.title: Inside the Gwinnett County police audit that exposed license plate data abuse
news.summary: Gwinnett County police officers face termination and criminal charges following an internal investigation into the misuse of license plate reader technology.

news.title: Pedestrian dies after being hit by train in Gwinnett County, police say
news.summary: A person was killed after being hit by a train in Gwinnett County on Friday night, according to Norfolk Southern officials and Gwinnett County police.

news.title: 2 students arrested after allegedly bringing gun to Wheeler High School
news.summary: Two students were arrested after bringing a gun to Wheeler High School on Thursday, according to the Cobb County School District.

news.title: Wanted man barricades himself in Clayton County apartment, arrested by SWAT
news.summary: Police executed a search warrant in the 1500 block of Pine Drive in Clayton County

news.title: Convicted felon sentenced after traffic stop leads to stolen gun arrest
news.summary: A metro Atlanta man with a criminal history is headed to federal prison for more than eight years after a traffic stop on I-75 led to the discovery of a stolen handgun, according to the U.S. Attorney'
